title: Accelerate Bioprocess Development with Console Software
summary: Optimize microbial fermentation with Nexxys’ integrated analytics and real-time monitoring for faster, data-driven decisions in bioprocess development.
body_markdown:
**What if every bioprocess experiment made the next one smarter?**


Today, process development often means moving between disconnected tools, spreadsheets, instruments, and datasets. That fragmentation creates manual work, and makes it harder to carry what you learn from one experiment into the next.


Console changes that by connecting the entire development cycle in one environment, from experimental design and execution to real-time monitoring, analysis, and optimization. Every run becomes part of a continuous learning cycle, with experimental context, process data, and insights staying connected as your process evolves.


With AI-guided experimental design through ChatDoE™, standardized and reusable recipes, remote monitoring and control, and integrated analytics, Console helps teams move more efficiently from a process question to an experiment, and from experimental results to the next development decision. Instead of rebuilding context at every step, scientists can build on what they’ve already learned and keep development moving forward.


**Complete the form to download the white paper and see how Console brings design, execution, data, analytics, and AI together in one connected environment.**
